questions.question: At the 2026 Winter Olympics, which country topped the final medal table with the highest total number of medals?
questions.questionHtml: At the 2026 Winter Olympics, which country topped the final medal table with the highest total number of medals?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Norway.

In News

  • The 2026 Winter Olympics were held from 6–22 February 2026 in Milan and Cortina d’Ampezzo, Italy.
  • Norway finished at the top of the medal table with a total of 41 medals, including 18 golds, 12 silvers, and 11 bronzes.
  • The United States finished second with 33 medals, while host Italy recorded one of its best Olympic performances with 30 medals.
  • These results were part of the official final standings after the Milano–Cortina 2026 Games concluded.

Additional Information

  • Milano–Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics
    • Official Winter Olympic Games held in northern Italy from February 6 to 22, 2026.
    • Featured 8 sports and 15 disciplines including the debut of ski mountaineering.
    • Closing ceremony took place on February 22, 2026. 
  • Norway’s Medal Dominance
    • Norwegian athletes led the final medal tally with 41 medals overall. 
    • This total included 18 gold medals, the highest of any nation at the Games. 
    • Norway has a strong tradition in Winter Olympic sports such as cross-country skiing, biathlon, and skating.
  • Other Top Performers
    • The United States finished second with 33 medals. 
    • The Netherlands recorded 20 total medals.
    • Host nation Italy achieved 30 medals, its best Winter Olympics performance.

questions.question: Which country was defeated by India in the final of the 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup?
questions.questionHtml: Which country was defeated by India in the final of the 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is New Zealand.

In News

  • The 2026 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup concluded with India defending their title against New Zealand.

Key Points

  • India defeated New Zealand by 96 runs in the final to win their third T20 World Cup title.
  • India posted a total of 255/5, the highest total in a men’s T20 World Cup final, while New Zealand was bowled out for 159.

Additional Points

  • Tournament Overview
    • Co-hosts - India and Sri Lanka
    • Participating Teams - 20 teams playing 55 matches
    • Final Match Venue - Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad
    • Winning Team - India (Defeated New Zealand by 96 runs)
  • Major Records & Stats
    • Total Prize Pool - USD 13.5 million
    • India's Only Defeat - Against South Africa in the Super 8s
    • Losing Semi-finalists - South Africa and England
    • India’s leading T20 WC overall wicket‑taker - Arshdeep Singh
  • Awards & Honours
    • Player of the Final - Jasprit Bumrah (4/15 in 4 overs)
    • Player of the Tournament - Sanju Samson (321 runs)
    • Most Runs (Tournament) - Sahibzada Farhan (383 runs)
    • Most Wickets (Tournament) - Jasprit Bumrah & Varun Chakravarthy (14 wickets each)

questions.question: Who became the first athlete in history to win 6 gold medals at a single Winter Olympics during the Milano Cortina 2026 Games?
questions.questionHtml: Who became the first athlete in history to win 6 gold medals at a single Winter Olympics during the Milano Cortina 2026 Games?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Johannes Høsflot Klæbo from Norway.

In News

  • Historic Achievement: Norwegian cross-country skier Johannes Høsflot Klæbo created history at the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympics.
  • Record-Breaking Performance: He became the first athlete in any sport to win 6 gold medals at a single edition of the Winter Olympic Games.
  • Career Milestone: With this performance, he increased his total career Winter Olympic gold medal tally to 11.

Key Highlights

  • Dominance in Cross-Country: Klæbo's dominance helped Norway finish at the top of the medal table with 18 gold medals, a record for a single nation.
  • All-Time Great: His 6-gold haul in 2026 surpassed the previous joint record of 5 golds in a single Winter Games (held by Eric Heiden in speed skating, 1980).

About Other Options

  • Mikaela Shiffrin (USA): A legendary alpine skier who reclaimed slalom gold at the 2026 Games, but did not win 6 golds.
  • Jutta Leerdam (Netherlands): A dominant speed skater who set an Olympic record in the women's 1000m at Milano Cortina 2026.
  • Yuto Totsuka (Japan): A star snowboarder who won the men's halfpipe gold medal in 2026.

questions.question: Who has been named the ‘Para Archer of the Year 2025’ by World Archery, becoming the first female armless archer to achieve this feat?
questions.questionHtml: Who has been named the ‘Para Archer of the Year 2025’ by World Archery, becoming the first female armless archer to achieve this feat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Sheetal Devi.

In News

  • On March 30, 2026, 19-year-old Sheetal Devi from Jammu and Kashmir was officially named World Archery’s ‘Para Archer of the Year 2025’.

Key Points

  • Historic Achievement: She is recognized as the world's first and only female armless archer to win a gold medal at the World Para Archery Championships (held in Gwangju, South Korea).
  • Medal Tally: She secured a complete set of medals at the World Championships: Gold (Individual), Silver (Women’s Team), and Bronze (Mixed Team).
  • Paralympic Success: She won a Bronze Medal in the Mixed Team category at the Paris Paralympics.
  • Unique Technique: Born without arms, she uses her feet, legs, and shoulder to draw the bow and execute shots.

Additional Information

  • World Archery Awards 2025 Winners:
    • Archer of the Year: Emircan Haney (Turkey)
    • Young Archer of the Year: Baptiste Addis (France)
    • Best Team: Republic of Korea’s Recurve Men’s Team
  • Regional Pride: Hailing from Kishtwar, Jammu and Kashmir, Sheetal has become a global icon for perseverance in para-sports.
